title: erysimum capitatum var. perenne
intro: Erysimum capitatum var. perenne, commonly known as Western Wallflower, is a perennial plant species in the family Brassicaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including anxiety, insomnia, and inflammation, due to its potential health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Western Wallflower include its sedative, anxiolytic, and anti-inflammatory effects, which may be attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as alkaloids, flavonoids, and terpenoids. Further research is needed to fully understand the bioactive constituents and therapeutic actions of Erysimum capitatum var. perenne.
